items.title: AI Assistant with Intelligent Memory
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN, We are building Engram, an AI assistant with persistent memory that actually works across sessions. Unlike ChatGPT/Claude, which forget everything after each chat, Engram extracts and indexes facts, preferences, and context automatically. The core problem: LLMs have great short-term memory but zero long-term recall. If you tell Claude about a project in January, it won't necessarily remember in March unless you paste the whole conversation back in.
